payload.claim: The new comment "# EXHAUSTED absorbs its own `PackageError`, as it always did, but a" writes the task state EXHAUSTED bare at the start of the sentence instead of backticked (`` `EXHAUSTED` ``), violating CONTEXT.md §10's rule that task states appear in backticks in prose. The comment is new, so it starts the prose ratchet fresh, and the very next line in the same comment correctly backticks `RuntimeError`, showing the omission is inconsistent within the same two-line comment.
